name: Assassin: diagnose coordinates after saved lock state

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p~=nil and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code:
local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_Assassin; assert(R and Game:GetProperty(R.TEST)==1); local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ASN_LIVE_TEST'); 
local b=t.Houses.CIVILIZATION_JAC_IMAGAWA
local city=Players[b]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); assert(city)
local dest=R.ResolveTarget(b,'LEADER'); assert(dest)
local x,y=city:GetX(),city:GetY()
local before={}; for _,u in Players[t.Actor]:GetUnits():Members() do before[u:GetID()]=true end
if x>=0 and y>=0 then UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(t.Actor,R.UNIT,x,y,1) end
local found; for _,u in Players[t.Actor]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if not before[u:GetID()] and R.IsAssassin(u) then found=u end
end
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ASN_PLACEMENT_PROBE',{Actor=t.Actor,Target=b,Unit=found and found:GetID()})
return 'city='..x..','..y..'; Gameplay destination='..dest.X..','..dest.Y..'; unit='..
  (found and (found:GetX()..','..found:GetY()) or 'not created')

local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_Assassin; assert(R and Game:GetProperty(R.TEST)==1); local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ASN_LIVE_TEST'); 
local p=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ASN_PLACEMENT_PROBE')
local city=Players[p.Target]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity()
local u=p.Unit and Players[p.Actor]:GetUnits():FindID(p.Unit)
return 'after returning to engine: city='..city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()..'; unit='..
  (u and (u:GetX()..','..u:GetY()) or 'not created')
